d: We're hiring a Field Sales Executive to win and grow HoReCa customers across Kuwait, face to face. You'll spend most of your day in the market visiting restaurants, hotels, cafés and caterers, and you'll report to the Sales Manager. Our office sales team backs you up with quotations, order processing and delivery.

FoodVera International Trading Company is a Kuwait-based importer and distributor of international food and FMCG brands. We supply hotels, restaurants, cafés and caterers, as well as supermarkets, wholesalers and grocery stores across Kuwait. We run a temperature-controlled warehouse in Sulaibiya and our own refrigerated delivery fleet, and we are ISO 22000 and ISO 9001 certified.
q: 2+ years of field sales in HoReCa, foodservice or FMCG distribution, ideally in Kuwait
Existing relationships with HoReCa buyers in Kuwait are a strong advantage
Currently in Kuwait with a transferable residency
Fluent English; Arabic is a strong advantage, Hindi or Urdu a plus
A confident negotiator who follows up until the order is closed and is comfortable with monthly targets
Organised and disciplined: you plan your own route and keep your records up to date
Experience selling frozen or chilled products is a plus
r: Visit restaurants, hotels, cafés, caterers and cloud kitchens every day, on a weekly route you plan with your manager
Open new accounts: find prospects in your area, meet chefs, F&B managers, purchasing managers and owners, and turn first meetings into first orders
Grow existing accounts by learning each customer's menu and volumes, and adding more of our range to what they buy
Present products and arrange samples and tastings with chefs and decision-makers
Negotiate within our HoReCa price list, close orders and pass them to the office for processing and delivery
Follow up deliveries, returns and complaints with the office and warehouse until the customer is satisfied
Collect payments and follow up overdue balances within agreed credit terms
Meet monthly targets for sales, new accounts and collections
Record visits, orders and customer feedback in Odoo, and report competitor prices, new openings and market trends
x: A growing portfolio of international food brands to sell
An office and warehouse team that handles quotations, orders and refrigerated delivery for your customers
Room to grow with an expanding company
